seoTitle: Sell on Nik Bag — list your handmade work
seoDescription: Bring handmade pieces to the Nik Bag vitrine. The platform share is clear: 10% of product sales, 8% after 50,000 ₺ in 90 days. Shipping is separate. Applying is free.

status.pendingText: You can upload products after approval. This usually doesn’t take long.
status.approvedText: Your seller account is approved. Bring your work to the vitrine.
status.rejectedText: Check your details and reach the support team.
status.suspendedText: Your account is temporarily paused. Contact support.

perks.safeText: Your session and application stay private.
perks.feeText: 10% of product sales. 8% after 50,000 ₺ in 90 days. Shipping is outside the fee.
perks.paceText: You set making and shipping time.
